currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always `"USD"`.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Cost amount in lowest currency units (e.g. cents) as a decimal string. For example, `"123.45"` in `"USD"` represents `$1.23`.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace this cost is associated with. `null` if not grouping by workspace or for the default workspace.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the cost item. `null` if not grouping by description.

cost_type.description: Type of cost. `null` if not grouping by description.

context_window.description: Input context window used. `null` if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name used. `null` if not grouping by description, for non-token costs, or for token costs with no model ID.

service_tier.description: Service tier used. `null` if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

token_type.description: Type of token. `null` if not grouping by description or for non-token costs.

inference_geo.title: Inference Geo
inference_geo.description:
Inference geo used matching requests' `inference_geo` parameter if set, otherwise the workspace's `default_inference_geo`.
For models that do not support specifying `inference_geo` the value is `"not_available"`. Always `null` if not grouping by inference geo.

speed.description: Speed used. `null` if not grouping by description, or for non-token costs.
